CC: Login Process BYOD (iOS)

Quick Reference Guide

| This Quick Reference Guide (QRG) shows how to log into the PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration Mobile Application on iOS BYOD. RED Steps \= 1st time login on device   BLACK Steps \= All future logins on device |
| :---: |

| Step 1: Download App  Open the App Store and search for PerfectServe Clinical Collab. Download the application Once installation is complete, select OPEN. \*Scan the QR code to navigate directly to the application in the App Store. ![][image1] |  | Step 2: Enterprise Login  Tap Enterprise Login  | ![][image2] |
| ----- | :---: | :---- | :---: |
| **Step 3: Enterprise   Domain**  Type **ascension** Tap **Next**  | ![][image3] | **Step 4: Ascension Credentials**  Sign in username \= **Ascension email** Tap **Next** Enter password \= **Network Password** Tap **Sign In**  | ![][image4] ![][image5] |
| **Step 5: Duo Push**  User will receive a Duo screen to either receive push/call to authenticate *\*If you do not have Duo setup on your device you will need to contact the Ascension Service Desk to do so. (877-635-0515)* | ![][image6] | **Step 6: Verify Device**  Prompt may display to remember device for future logins Tap option that pertains to your situation  | ![][image7] |
| **Step 7: Validate Phone Number**  First time login will require you to validate your mobile number Tap **Validate** | ![][image8] | **Step 8: Send Text**  To complete number validation you must send the text presented on screen Tap Send | ![][image9] |
| **Step 7: Permissions**  List displays showing the permissions the app will request on device to ensure it works correctly Tap **Next**  | ![][image10] | **Step 8: Permissions**  App sending **notifications** \= Tap **ALLOW**  App sending **Critical Alerts** \= Tap **ALLOW** App access to **Mic \=** Tap **ALLOW** | ![][image11] ![][image12] ![][image13] |
| **Step 9: Biometrics**  Choose to **Enable** or **Skip** biometric login If Enable then choose to **Allow** or **Don’t Allow** Face ID  | ![][image14] | **Step 10: PIN**  Create a 4 digit PIN Re-enter 4 digit PIN to confirm | ![][image15] |
| **\*\*First Time Login\*\*** ACCEPT the e911 Disclaimer message.  | ![][image16] |  |  |
| **\*Steps Below ONLY Applicable to SHIFT workers  (those who sign into a shift for a set amount of time)** |  |  |  |
| **\*Step 11: Roles**  *\*Only applicable to SHIFT workers* Select the Role(s) you will be covering for the shift from Available Roles Tap **Assume Selected Roles** | ![][image17] | **\*Step 12: Shift Time**  Select the time your shift ends Tap **Set Shift End Time** | ![][image18] |
